 The Indianapolis Colts have been crumbling each passing week.
 But with Chris Ballard out the door, interim GM Ed Dodds could be looking to shuffle around the roster.
 Part of those moves could involve running back Jonathan Taylor.
 Colts Trade Pitch Acquires Package From New York Giants
 GettyINDIANAPOLIS, INDIANA – OCTOBER 18: Jonathan Taylor #28 of the Indianapolis Colts runs with the ball against Cedric Gray #33 of the Tennessee Titans during the second quarter of the game at Lucas Oil Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Indianapolis, Indiana. (Photo by Andy Lyons/Getty Images)
 Austen Bundy of FanSided proposed a significant trade between the Colts and the Giants.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here's how it would shake out:
 Colts receive: 
 Kayvon Thibodeaux (DE)
 Tyrone Tracy Jr. (RB)
 2027 Second-Round Pick
 Giants receive: 
 Jonathan Taylor (RB)
 As noted by Bundy, "Irsay and the new GM would really want a fresh slate for the team for this to happen. A second-round pick next year helps them find a new playmaker on either side of the ball. They could even move Thibodeaux a second time for more draft capital. It's a lot of risk on Indianapolis' part but the environment for such a risk to be taken is starting to brew.
 "There's a little bit of a Saquon Barkley factor as well with Taylor deserving a change of scenery to chase a championship (something that may become more likely if he elevates a team like New York)."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Taylor had a productive 2025 campaign and finished the season with 323 carries for 1,585 rushing yards, averaging 4.9 yards per carry through 17 games.
 He posted 18 touchdowns.
 So far this season, he has registered 122 carries for 492 yards, averaging 4.0 yards per carry with seven touchdowns across six games.
